text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Do you know what day it is?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Why, of course I do!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is none other... than the day I was
entrusted
with my very first solo errand!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? No way! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, no, no, no! That's not it! Today's a special day for me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Is it the day you first ran in a
race,
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, not that either! Hm, okay,
here's a
hint—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We only jest—it was a surprise! My
teasing
heightened the suspense, did it
not?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us celebrate this joyful
occasion!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Urara! Here's to a good
year
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got a little nervous there...
Happy
birthday!
